title: dsc_pileup
description:
Dsc-pileup is a software tool to pileup reads and corresponding base quality 
for each overlapping SNPs and each barcode. By using pileup files,
it would allow us to run demuxlet/freemuxlet pretty fast multiple times
without going over the BAM file again.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

sam.description: Input SAM/BAM/CRAM file. Must be sorted by coordinates and indexed.

tag_group.description: Tag representing readgroup or cell barcodes, in the case to partition the BAM file into multiple groups. For 10x genomics, use CB.

tag_umi.description: Tag representing UMIs. For 10x genomiucs, use UB.

vcf.description: Input VCF/BCF file for dsc-pileup, containing the AC and AN field.

sm.description: List of sample IDs to compare to (default: use all).

sm_list.description: File containing the list of sample IDs to compare.

skip_umi.description: Do not generate [prefix].umi.gz file, which stores the regions covered by each barcode/UMI pair.

cap_bq.description: Maximum base quality (higher BQ will be capped).

min_bq.description: Minimum base quality to consider (lower BQ will be skipped).

min_mq.description: Minimum mapping quality to consider (lower MQ will be ignored).

min_td.description: Minimum distance to the tail (lower will be ignored).

excl_flag.description: SAM/BAM FLAGs to be excluded for SNP overlapping Read filtering Options.

group_list.description: List of tag readgroup/cell barcode to consider in this run. All other barcodes will be ignored. This is useful for parallelized run.

min_total.description: Minimum number of total reads for a droplet/cell to be considered.

min_uniq.description: Minimum number of unique reads (determined by UMI/SNP pair) for a droplet/cell to be considered.

min_snp.description: Minimum number of SNPs with coverage for a droplet/cell to be considered.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
